description: Works a lease quote from the MSRP, selling price, residual and money factor (or the lease's APR): the depreciation and rent charges, the monthly payment with the state's lease tax, the money factor as an APR, and the total cost, including any tax charged once at the start (Texas, Ohio and others). With a loan APR and term, it also compares leasing with buying the same car over the lease's months. Use it to check a lease offer's numbers; for buying, use out_the_door.

buy_apr.description: A loan APR, to compare with buying

buy_out_the_door.description: Out-the-door price when buying; leave out to estimate it

buy_term_months.description: Loan term, to compare with buying

city.description: City or county in the state's rate table (23 states; state_rules says which), like Pittsburgh or Allegheny County: sets the combined rate from the state's own rate file. Where a city is in several counties (Chicago, Milwaukee), give county too. A place name only, never an address or ZIP

county.description: County from the state's list (Pennsylvania, Nevada, Wisconsin; state_rules lists them), like Allegheny County: sets the combined rate. A county name only, never an address or ZIP

doc_fee.description: Doc fee when buying, for the estimated out-the-door; leave out to assume the state's cap, or a typical $450 where there is none

due_at_signing.description: Cash down, lease rebates and trade equity that lower the price

fees.description: Acquisition and other fees rolled into the lease

lease_apr.description: The lease's rate as an APR, instead of the money factor

residual_percent.description: Residual as a percent of MSRP (58 for 58%)

selling_price.description: The negotiated price the lease is built on

state.description: Two-letter state code (DC included), like PA

tax_rate.description: Combined sales tax rate as a decimal (state and local); leave out to use the state's rate. A state lease tax (Pennsylvania's 3%) is added on top either way; Alabama's and West Virginia's own lease-payment rates replace their state sales rate; where the state taxes a lease once at the start (Texas, Ohio), this is that tax's rate and the payments carry none

name: lease_check
title: Check a lease
